user.title: Connect to Trail-Safe
user.description: Enter your Trail-Safe server URL and API key. You can create an API key in the Trail-Safe dashboard under Integrations.

reauth_confirm.title: Trail-Safe API key no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {server_url} was revoked or is invalid. Create a new one in the Trail-Safe dashboard under Integrations and paste it here. Your trackers and their history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Trail-Safe server.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Generate one in the Trail-Safe dashboard.
error.paid_plan_required: API keys require a paid Trail-Safe plan (Single, Family or Family Plus).

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key works. Trail-Safe is reconnected.

paid_plan_required.title: Trail-Safe: paid plan required
paid_plan_required.description: {title} stopped updating because the Trail-Safe account that owns its API key is no longer on a paid plan (Single, Family or Family Plus). Renew the plan in the Trail-Safe dashboard; the trackers resume on their own, no change in Home Assistant needed.
